name: Abruzzo Rural Property
description: English-speaking specialist in Abruzzo and Molise rural property since 2012. Provides complete transaction support: document checks, legal services, English-speaking notary coordination, surveyor management. Many of the Colledimezzo-type properties on this site are handled by this agency.
note: One of the most trusted English-speaking agents for affordable Abruzzo properties.

name: IRECOM (Italian Real Estate Company)
description: Full-service multi-region buyer's agent covering all of Italy. Handles property search, legal and tax consultancy, renovation oversight, and rental management. Single point of contact for the entire purchase journey.
note: Best for buyers who want hand-holding through the whole process.

name: House Troina
description: Official municipal agency for Troina's €1 house programme. Provides English-language assistance, property catalogues, contractor referrals, and programme guidance. Also coordinates the renovation grant applications (€15K restyle + €10K energy = up to €25K).
note: The most professionally run €1 programme with genuine English support.

name: Case 1 Euro — Mussomeli
description: Official Mussomeli €1 house programme website with property listings, registration details and contact information. The programme has sold 200+ homes to buyers from 30+ countries and has an established international community with English-speaking local agents.
note: Italy's most established €1 programme with the largest international buyer community.

name: Mirafortis
description: Independent buyer's agent working exclusively for the buyer — not tied to any seller portfolio. Provides full market access across Italy and property vetting service for foreign buyers.
fee: Fixed fee or % (check current terms on website)
note: Good choice if you want truly independent representation with no seller conflict of interest.

name: 1EuroHouses.com
description: The most comprehensive directory of all active €1 house programmes in Italy. Lists 70+ municipalities with programme details, requirements, contacts and links to official town pages. Essential starting point for €1 buyers.
note: Use this to contact individual municipalities and get current property availability.

name: Gate-Away.com
description: Best English-language Italian property portal for international buyers. 45,000+ listings with price filters, region search and direct contact with sellers/agents. All listings on this website have been sourced and verified through Gate-Away.
fee: Free to search; agent commissions apply when purchasing
note: The easiest Italian property portal for English speakers with a budget filter.

name: Idealista.it
description: Italy's largest property portal by volume, with 500,000+ listings. Full English language site available. Excellent filtering including price range, property type (rustici/casali), and region. Most comprehensive coverage of cheap rural properties.
note: Largest database. Use with 'country house' filter and price max €50,000 for best results.

name: Immobiliare.it
description: Italy's market-leading property portal. Full English version available. Excellent for rural properties — 362+ listings in Calabria alone under the 'rustici' category. Good for cross-checking properties found elsewhere.
note: Best for verification — if a property is on both Idealista and Immobiliare, it's more likely to be genuine.

name: YourHostHelper Italy
regions: Major Italian cities and tourist regions
description: Full-service Airbnb concierge management covering most Italian tourist regions. Handles guest communication, check-in/out, cleaning coordination, maintenance requests and pricing optimisation. Essential if you're a non-resident Airbnb host.
note: Management fee does not include cleaning costs — those are charged separately to guests or you.

name: Italian Commercialista (Tax Accountant)
regions: All Italy — find one local to your property
description: A commercialista is an Italian certified accountant essential for all foreign property owners. They file your annual Italian tax return (Redditi P.F.), manage Airbnb income reporting (cedolare secca 21%), handle IMU property tax payments (twice yearly — NOT automatic), and advise on 7% flat tax eligibility. Budget €500–1,000/year for ongoing services.
note: Critical. IMU property tax is NOT automatically billed — you must calculate and pay it yourself using F24 form. A commercialista prevents costly mistakes.

name: Italian Notaio (Notary)
description: In Italy, all property purchases must be completed before a notaio — a state-appointed legal official who verifies title, checks for debts/liens, registers the deed and collects registration tax. You don't choose your notaio like you would a solicitor — any registered notaio can handle the transaction. Fees are regulated by law.
note: Non-negotiable requirement for any property purchase in Italy. Budget this as a fixed cost.
